rationale: The agent added two new strptime format strings with %z to the existing _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround list rather than replacing the brittle format-guessing approach (e.g., with a proper ISO-8601 parser like datetime.fromisoformat or dateutil), so the underlying defect of enumerating formats one-by-one remains and future timestamp variants will likely fail the same way. The Globex date-only end-of-day handling in Europe/Madrid was untouched by this diff, so the protected behavior is preserved.
